surface.title: Useful in under 60 seconds.
surface.body: Folio starts from the user job, not from a dashboard setup.
surface.plainText: Payday You can see what has to last until payday. Debt Debt payments sit beside bills and income. Bills Bills before income are visible together. Bank activity Rows found to check. Nothing has been added yet. Unsure Start with one thing: money available today. Every first win stays review-first and inspectable.
